A strong tornado in [[Ninh Bình province]] killed nine people and injured 18 others.{{Cite web |last=VietNamNet |date=2025-09-30 |title=Horrific tornado in Ninh Binh kills 9 people: Witness recounts life-and-death moments |url=https://www.vietnam.vn/en/giong-loc-kinh-hoang-o-ninh-binh-khien-9-nguoi-chet-nhan-chung-ke-phut-sinh-tu |access-date=2025-09-30 |website=vietnam.vn |language=en}} Another tornado in [[Hưng Yên province]] killed two and injured nine,{{cite news |url=https://www.sggp.org.vn/hung-yen-2-nguoi-thiet-mang-9-nguoi-bi-thuong-do-dong-loc-post815422.html |title=Hưng Yên: 2 người thiệt mạng, 9 người bị thương do dông lốc |work=[[Sài Gòn Giải Phóng]] |date=29 September 2025 |access-date=30 September 2025}} and a third tornado in [[Haiphong]] injured eight people.{{cite news |url=https://baohaiphong.vn/nhieu-dia-phuong-o-hai-phong-khan-truong-khac-phuc-hau-qua-sau-tran-dong-loc-522110.html |work=Hai Phong News |date=29 September 2025 |access-date=30 September 2025 |title=Nhiều địa phương ở Hải Phòng khẩn trương khắc phục hậu quả sau trận dông lốc}} Two other tornadoes caused a total of nine injuries in [[Quảng Ninh province|Quảng Ninh]] and north of [[Hanoi]]. Additionally, 20 tornadoes were confirmed in Southern China, specifically the [[Zhanjiang]] area, from September 25–29. Most were rated EFU, EF0 or EF1, although one was rated EF2.{{cite news |url=https://www.chinanews.com.cn/dwq/2025/10-05/10494206.shtml |script-title=zh:台风“博罗依”致广东湛江先后发生20个龙卷风 |date=5 October 2025 |access-date=8 October 2025 |work=China News |trans-title=Typhoon Bualoi spawned 20 tornadoes in Zhanjiang, Guangdong}} {{clear}} ==October== === October 4 (Norway) === A rare, strong landspout struck the village of [[Oppdal (village)|Oppdal]] in Norway. The landspout was recorded as it moved through downtown Oppdal where it downed trees, overturned caravans, and smashed windows. At least 3 people were injured. This landspout was rated IF2 and information is still preliminary and subject to change. {{clear}} === October 5 (Bangladesh) === During the morning hours of October 5, a damaging tornado struck portions of [[Nilphamari District]] and [[Rangpur Division]] in northern Bangladesh amid heavy rainfall and convective storms. The tornado destroyed or damaged hundreds of homes across several villages, particularly within [[Garagram Union]] and parts of [[Gangachara Upazila]]. Numerous trees were uprooted, power lines were downed, and roads were obstructed by debris. At least 30 people were injured, several of whom required hospitalization. Local authorities and relief agencies conducted damage assessments and distributed emergency assistance to affected residents.{{cite news |title=Tornado destroys over 500 houses in Nilphamari, injures 30 |work=Dhaka Tribune |url=https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/nation/393287/tornado-destroys-over-500-houses-in-nilphamari |date=October 5, 2025 |access-date=February 1, 2026}}{{cite web |title=Tornado damages 1,200 thatched houses, uprooting trees in Rangpur |website=Bangladesh Sangbad Sangstha |date=October 5, 2025 |url=https://www.bssnews.net/district/318227 |access-date=February 1, 2026}}{{cite report |title=Bangladesh: Tornado and heavy rain emergency response operation update |publisher=International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies |date=October 2025 |url=https://go.ifrc.org/emergencies/7663/details |access-date=February 1, 2026}} {{clear}} === October 20 (Europe) === {{Tornado chart small IF-scale| IFU = 0 | IF0 = 0 | IF0.5 = 3 |IF1 = 3 | IF1.5 = 0| IF2 = 1 | IF2.5 = 0 | IF3 = 0 | IF4 = 0 | IF5 = 0}} A widespread severe weather outbreak produced multiple tornadoes across western Europe on October 20, affecting the [[United Kingdom]], [[France]], and the [[Netherlands]], resulting in one fatality and numerous injuries. In the United Kingdom, a brief IF0.5 tornado struck [[Dereham]], causing minor damage to homes and trees. The event was confirmed by [[TORRO]], which documented light structural and roof damage along a short path.{{cite web |title=Tornado confirmed at Dereham, Norfolk on 20 October 2025 |publisher=TORRO |url=https://www.torro.org.uk/reports/tornado-dereham-2025 |access-date=February 1, 2026}} In the Netherlands, a brief IF0.5 tornado was observed near [[Woudsend]], where part of a barn roof was damaged and tree branches were snapped.{{cite news |title=Windhoos veroorzaakt schade aan schuur bij Woudsend |work=Leeuwarder Courant |language=nl |date=20 October 2025 |url=https://www.lc.nl/friesland/sudwest/windhoos-woudsend-schade-schuur-2025 |access-date=February 1, 2026}} The most significant impacts occurred in France, where several tornadoes touched down as supercell thunderstorms moved northeastward across the country. The strongest tornado struck [[Ermont]] and surrounding communities including [[Argenteuil]], [[Eaubonne]], and [[Franconville, Val-d'Oise|Franconville]]. Rated IF2, the tornado carved a damage path up to {{convert|14|km|mi|abbr=on}} long and as wide as {{convert|600|m|yd|abbr=on}}, tearing roofs from buildings, collapsing three tower cranes, overturning vehicles, and scattering debris across streets. A 23-year-old worker was killed, four people were left in critical condition, and several others sustained injuries. Dozens of residents were temporarily displaced as emergency shelters were opened.{{cite news |title=Une tornade meurtrière frappe le Val-d'Oise, un mort et plusieurs blessés graves |work=France Info |language=fr |date=October 20, 2025 |url=https://www.francetvinfo.fr/meteo/orages/tornade-val-doise-ermont-un-mort-plusieurs-blesses |access-date=February 1, 2026}}{{cite web |title=Rapport d'enquête – Tornade IF2 d'Ermont (Val-d'Oise) |publisher=KERAUNOS |language=fr |url=https://www.keraunos.org/actualites/faits-marquants/2025/tornade-ermont-val-doise |access-date=February 1, 2026}} Additional weaker tornadoes occurred elsewhere in France. IF1 to IF0.5 tornadoes caused roof and tree damage near [[Anglesqueville-la-Bras-Long]], [[Michery]], [[Chaumont-en-Vexin]], and [[Chambley-Bussières]], where farms, homes, and agricultural structures sustained varying degrees of damage, with sheets of metal and debris carried hundreds of meters from their points of origin.{{cite web |title=Plusieurs tornades observées en France le 20 octobre 2025 – synthèse des enquêtes |publisher=KERAUNOS |language=fr |url=https://www.keraunos.org/actualites/bilans/tornades-france-20-octobre-2025 |access-date=February 1, 2026}} {{clear}} === October 25–27 (United States) === {{Tornado chart small|Enhanced=yes|FU=0|F0=7|F1=5|F2=0|F3=0|F4=0|F5=0}} A small QLCS tornado event occurred mainly along the [[Gulf Coast of the United States|Gulf Coast]] of the [[Southern United States]] from October 25–27. A total of ten tornadoes were confirmed, including two waterspouts that came ashore in [[Mexico Beach, Florida]], one of which damaged or rolled over several RVs, resulting in 10 injuries.{{cite web | last=Velez | first=Grace | title=2 tornadoes hit Mexico Beach leaving trail of destruction and some without homes | website=WMBB Panama City via Yahoo News | date=2025-10-29 | url=https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/2-tornadoes-hit-mexico-beach-000515080.html | access-date=2025-10-29}}{{cite web | title=IEM :: PNS from NWS TAE | website=Iowa Environmental Mesonet | date=2025-10-28 | url=https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/wx/afos/p.php?pil=PNSTAE&e=202510281856 | access-date=2025-10-29}} In addition, a rare EF0 rated landspout touched down north of [[Rigby, Idaho]].{{cite report|author=National Weather Service in Pocatello, Idaho|title=Live Storm Reports|url=https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/lsr/?by=wfo&wfo=PIH&sts=202510272050&ets=202510272050&settings=1110100|publisher=Iowa Environmental Mesonet|date=October 27, 2025|access-date=December 17, 2025}} {{clear}} === October 27–28 (Turkey) === {{Tornado chart small IF-scale| IFU = 0 | IF0 = 0 | IF0.5 = 0 |IF1 = 1 | IF1.5 = 2 | IF2 = 2 | IF2.5 = 0 | IF3 = 0 | IF4 = 0 | IF5 = 0}} A series of tornadoes associated with severe thunderstorms swept across northwestern Turkey, impacting several rural communities and causing structural damage and one fatality across two days. On October 27, an IF1 tornado struck [[Enez]] and an IF1.5 occurred in the area of [[Eşeler, Balıkesir Province|Eşeler]] village, where roofs were partially removed from homes and telegraph and light poles were damaged or knocked down. More significant damage occurred on October 28 as stronger tornadoes tracked across villages in [[Ankara Province]], including an IF2 impacting [[Çantırlı, Beypazarı|Çantırlı]], an IF1.5 striking [[Dibecik, Beypazarı|Dibecik]], and a strong IF2 affecting [[İlhanköy, Ayaş|İlhanköy]]. Entire roofs were lifted and thrown from residences, garden structures and fences were destroyed, and several mosque towers sustained heavy damage, with at least one partially collapsing. In İlhanköy, a 40-year-old man was killed after being struck by debris from an overturned container, while three children sheltering inside were injured. Emergency crews responded across the region to clear debris, assess damage, and assist displaced residents.{{cite news |title=Storms and tornadoes damage homes in northwestern Turkey, one killed |publisher=Anadolu Agency |date=October 28, 2025 |url=https://www.aa.com.tr/en/turkey/storms-and-tornadoes-damage-homes-in-northwestern-turkey-one-killed/}}{{cite news |title=Severe weather hits Bilecik villages, mosque minarets and roofs collapse |work=Daily Sabah |date=October 28, 2025 |url=https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/severe-weather-hits-bilecik-villages-roofs-and-minarets-collapse/news}} {{clear}} === October 29 (Spain) === On the morning of October 29, a vigorous storm system producing torrential rain and severe thunderstorms affected parts of [[Andalusia]], including the coastal [[province of Huelva]]. In [[Gibraleón]], a strong tornado struck the town, toppling trees and damaging roofs and structures amid heavy winds. The [[State Meteorological Agency|State Meteorological Agency (AEMET)]] later confirmed that the circulation responsible for the damage reached wind speeds of up to {{convert|220|km/h|mph|abbr=on}}, consistent with an IF2 tornado. A 59-year-old man in Gibraleón was seriously injured by a falling structure during the event and died two days later from his injuries.{{cite news |title=AEMET confirma que el tornado que causó una muerte en Gibraleón alcanzó los 220 km/h |work=Huelva Información |language=es |date=December 3, 2025 |url=https://www.huelvainformacion.es/provincia/aemet-confirma-tornado-causo-muerte-gibraleon-octubre-220-kilometros_0_2005380921.html |access-date=February 1, 2026}}{{cite news |title=Un tornado causa decenas de incidencias en Gibraleón (Huelva) |work=Cadena SER |language=es |date=October 29, 2025 |url=https://cadenaser.com/andalucia/2025/10/29/un-tornado-causa-decenas-de-incidencias-en-gibraleon-huelva-radio-huelva/ |access-date=February 1, 2026}} Around the same time, a waterspout came ashore in the [[Isla Cristina]] area of the Huelva coast, where it caused additional damage to trees, roofs, and other light structures amid the broader storm impacts. This tornado was rated IF1. Although no serious injuries were reported from the Isla Cristina event, emergency services responded to numerous incidents across the region as heavy rain and strong winds produced flooding, fallen trees, and infrastructure disruptions.{{cite news |title=Stronger storms bring flooding, fierce winds and tornado reports to Huelva province |work=Euro Weekly News |date=October 29, 2025 |url=https://euroweeklynews.com/2025/10/29/huelva-and-seville-hit-hardest-as-floods-cause-over-900-emergencies-and-one-man-fights-for-his-life/ |access-date=February 1, 2026}} {{clear}} ==November== === November 6 (Typhoon Kalmaegi) === Outer rainbands from [[Typhoon Kalmaegi]] produced a tornado that struck [[Long Phụng commune|Long Phung]], [[Quảng Ngãi province|Quảng Ngãi]], in Vietnam, causing localized but significant damage to residential areas. Numerous homes sustained roof loss or structural damage, with several light structures and outbuildings destroyed. Trees and power poles were snapped or uprooted, blocking roads and disrupting electrical service to surrounding neighborhoods. Multiple residents were injured by flying debris and collapsing materials, and several families were temporarily displaced as local authorities conducted damage assessments and cleared debris. Emergency crews and provincial officials provided assistance and began repairs shortly after the storm passed.{{Cite web |date=2025-11-06 |title=Fierce tornado in Quang Ngai causes dozens of houses to lose roofs |url=https://news.laodong.vn/xa-hoi/loc-du-doi-o-quang-ngai-khien-hang-chuc-nha-dan-toc-mai-1604953.ldo |access-date=2025-11-07 |website=news.laodong.vn |language=en}}{{cite news |title=Kalmaegi leaves five fatalities, widespread destruction across Central Vietnam |work=Saigon Giai Phong |date=November 7, 2025 |url=https://en.sggp.org.vn/kalmaegi-leaves-five-fatalities-widespread-destruction-across-central-vietnam-post121586.html|access-date=February 1, 2026}}{{cite news |title=South Central region devastated after typhoon Kalmaegi |work=SGGP |date=November 7, 2025 |url=https://en.sggp.org.vn/south-central-region-devastated-after-typhoon-kalmaegi-post121601.html|access-date=February 1, 2026}} {{clear}} === November 7 (Brazil) === {{Main|2025 Southern Brazil tornado outbreak|2025 Rio Bonito do Iguaçu tornado}} {{Tornado chart small|FU = 1|F0 = 0|F1 = 6|F2 = 1|F3 = 0|F4 = 2|F5 = 0}} [[File:Tornado Rio Bonito do Iguaçu satelite.jpg|thumb|Damage from Rio Bonito do Iguaçu tornado seen from satellite.]] A small but significant outbreak of tornadoes caused widespread damage within [[South Region, Brazil|Southern Brazil]], including a violent tornado that devastated the town of [[Rio Bonito do Iguaçu]], where an estimated 90% of the town's structures were damaged or destroyed. At least five fatalities and upwards of 780 injuries have been reported in the city; hospitals are reportedly inundated with casualties.{{cite news |url=https://www.cbsnews.com/news/tornado-brazil-panara-rio-bonito-do-iguacu/ |title=Powerful tornado flattens Brazilian town, killing at least 6 and injuring hundreds |date=8 November 2025 |access-date=8 November 2025 |publisher=CBS News}}{{Cite news |date=November 8, 2025 |title=Tornado in southern Brazil kills six, injures hundreds |url=https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/tornado-southern-brazil-kills-six-injures-hundreds-2025-11-08/ |access-date=November 8, 2025 |work=Reuters}}{{cite news |url=https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/brasil/tornado-causa-destruicao-no-interior-do-parana/ |language=pt-BR |title=Tornado causa destruição e mortes no interior do Paraná |work=Gazeta do Povo |date=8 November 2025 |access-date=8 November 2025 |last1=Abrão |first1=Camila |last2=Fantin |first2=Rafael}} Experts from [[PREVOTS]], MetSul Meteorologia and SIMEPAR rated this tornado an F4.{{Cite tweet |author=PREVOTS |user=prevots_svr |number=1987549004448559227 |date=9 November 2025 |access-date=10 November 2025 |title=Pelo menos 8 tornados foram identificados em SC e PR na última sexta-feira. Vamos atualizar os dados nos próximos dias. |trans-title=At least eight tornadoes were identified in Santa Catarina and Paraná last Friday. The most significant tornado, which struck Rio Bonito do Iguaçu, received a preliminary F4 rating in our database based on the damage in the city. We will update the data in the coming days. |language=pt-br |archive-url=https://archive.today/20251110035343/https://x.com/prevots_svr/status/1987549004448559227 |archive-date=10 November 2025}}{{cite web |author1=Estael Sias |author2=Luiz Nachtigall |title=Tornado que atingiu o Paraná pode ter sido um EF-4 com vento de até 300 km/h |url=https://metsul.com/tornado-que-atingiu-o-parana-pode-ter-sido-um-ef-4-com-vento-de-ate-300-km-h/ |publisher=MetSul Meteorologia |access-date=11 November 2025 |language=pt-br |date=9 November 2025 |trans-title=Tornado that struck Paraná may have been an EF-4 with winds up to 300 km/h}}{{cite web | title=Laudo técnico final do Simepar eleva classificação de tornados que atingiram 11 cidades do Paraná | website=Governo do Estado do Paraná | date=2025-11-26 | url=https://www.parana.pr.gov.br/aen/Noticia/Laudo-tecnico-final-do-Simepar-eleva-classificacao-de-tornados-que-atingiram-11-cidades | language=pt | ref={{sfnref|Governo do Estado do Paraná|2025}} | access-date=2025-11-30}} The event has been called "unprecedented," with [[Ratinho Júnior|the governor]] of [[Paraná (state)|Paraná]] adding that the tornado was the strongest to hit the state in decades.{{cite news |url=https://www.cnn.com/2025/11/08/americas/brazil-tornado-weather-parana-intl |title='Unprecedented' tornado tears through southern Brazil, killing at least six |publisher=CNN |last1=Schroeder |first1=Lucas |last2=Coelho |first2=Flávio |date=8 November 2025 |access-date=8 November 2025}}{{cite news |url=https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/geral/noticia/2025-11/tornado-destroi-90-de-cidade-no-parana-e-causa-seis-mortes |date=8 November 2025 |access-date=8 November 2025 |language=pt-BR |title=Tornado destrói 90% de cidade no Paraná e causa seis mortes |last=Pordeus León |first=Lucas}} At least seven other tornadoes were recorded in neighboring regions, one of which, also rated F4, killed another person in the neighboring city of [[Guarapuava]]. Another death was recorded in the [[Municipalities of Brazil|municipality]] of [[Rolante]], [[Rio Grande do Sul]] after a man was struck by a falling tree as a result of non-tornadic winds from the extratropical cyclone that produced these storms.{{cite web |title=Ciclone no Sul teve 4 tornados, deixou 7 mortos e espalhou destruição |url=https://metsul.com/ciclone-no-sul-teve-4-tornados-deixou-7-mortos-e-espalhou-destruicao/ |website=MetSul Meteorologia |access-date=9 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251109094608/https://metsul.com/ciclone-no-sul-teve-4-tornados-deixou-7-mortos-e-espalhou-destruicao/ |archive-date=9 November 2025 |language=pt-br |date=8 November 2025 |trans-title=Cyclone in the South had 4 tornadoes, left 7 dead, and spread destruction}} The tornado outbreak was the first recorded instance of multiple violent tornadoes in South America on a single day since [[Tornadoes of 2009#September 7-8 (South America)|2009]].{{Cite web |title=Tornado que atingiu Guarapuava é reclassificado como F4 |url=https://redesuldenoticias.com.br/noticias/tornado-que-atingiu-guarapuava-e-reclassificado-como-f4/ |access-date=2025-11-20 |website=RSN |date=November 19, 2025 |language=pt-BR}} {{clear}} === November 15 (Portugal and Italy) === {{Tornado chart small IF-scale| IFU = 2| IF0 = 1| IF0.5 = 2|IF1 = 1| IF1.5 = 1| IF2 = 2| IF2.5 = 0| IF3 = 0| IF4 = 0| IF5 = 0}} A damaging tornado struck the [[Albufeira]] area of [[Algarve]], Portugal on November 15, impacting the Eden Resort campsite and nearby neighborhoods. Numerous mobile homes and light structures were overturned or destroyed, and many trees were snapped or uprooted. An 85-year-old British woman was killed, and 28 people were injured, including two seriously. The tornado was assigned a preliminary IF2 rating based on the extent of structural and tree damage.{{cite news |title=Woman killed and dozens injured as tornado hits Albufeira campsite |work=The Portugal News |date=November 15, 2025 |url=https://www.theportugalnews.com/news/2025-11-15/woman-killed-and-28-injured-as-tornado-hits-albufeira-campsite/93412 |access-date=February 1, 2026}}{{cite news |title=Tornado provoca mortos e feridos no Algarve e destrói casas móveis em Albufeira |work=Público |language=pt |date=November 15, 2025 |url=https://www.publico.pt/2025/11/15/sociedade/noticia/tornado-albufeira-feridos-casas-moveis-destruidas-2079451 |access-date=February 1, 2026}} A second tornado touched down near [[Lagoa, Portugal|Lagoa]], where trees and trailers were damaged along a northeastward track. The circulation originated as a waterspout before moving inland and continued through rural areas toward [[Aivados]], [[Poço Deão]], and [[Ribeira, Algarve|Ribeira]]. Damage surveys indicated major branch loss and structural impacts consistent with a preliminary IF2 intensity. Together, the two tornadoes represented one of the most significant late-season severe weather events in southern Portugal in recent years.{{cite news |title=Waterspout-turned-tornado damages Lagoa area during Algarve storm |work=The Portugal News |date=November 16, 2025 |url=https://www.theportugalnews.com/news/2025-11-16/waterspout-turns-tornado-and-damages-lagoa-area/93444 |access-date=February 1, 2026}} The same storm system produced multiple tornadoes and waterspouts across coastal [[Liguria]] in Italy, particularly around the [[Genoa]] [[Metropolitan City of Genoa|metropolitan area]]. The strongest tornado, rated IF1.5, struck [[Pegli]], where trees and large branches were downed, roofs and windows were damaged, light objects were lofted or displaced, a small boat was moved, and a truck was overturned.{{cite news |title=Tromba d'aria a Pegli: alberi abbattuti, tetti danneggiati e camion ribaltato |work=La Repubblica Genova |language=it |date=November 15, 2025 |url=https://genova.repubblica.it/cronaca/2025/11/15/news/tromba_daria_pegli_danni_camion_ribaltato-423812945/ |access-date=February 1, 2026}} Additional weaker tornadoes affected nearby communities. Containers were tipped over in [[Pra'|Prà]], light roof and tree damage occurred in [[Sestri Ponente]] and [[Quarto dei Mille]], and several brief waterspouts or weak tornadoes were documented near [[Crevari]], [[Albaro]], and [[Bogliasco]], producing little to minor damage. No casualties were reported in Italy.{{cite news |title=Maltempo in Liguria: trombe marine e danni tra Pegli, Pra' e Levante genovese |work=ANSA Liguria |language=it |date=November 15, 2025 |url=https://www.ansa.it/liguria/notizie/2025/11/15/maltempo-trombe-marine-e-danni-tra-pegli-pra-e-levante-genovese_9f4b7e6b.html |access-date=February 1, 2026}} {{clear}} === November 16–17 (Vietnam) === Two tornadoes were reported from November 16 to 17 in the south-central coast of Vietnam. The first was a short-lived but destructive tornado that impacted [[Phú Ninh District]], south of [[Da Nang]] city, injuring four people. The tornado damaged around 56 structures, including 27 homes with torn roofs and three houses being destroyed.{{Cite web |date=2025-11-17 |title=Tornado rips through Da Nang's southern part, damaging dozens of homes |url=https://news.tuoitre.vn/tornado-rips-through-da-nangs-southern-part-damaging-dozens-of-homes-10325111715291538.htm |access-date=2025-11-17 |website=Tuoi tre news }} A second tornado occurred a few hours later on November 17 in Nguyễn Nghiêm, [[Quảng Ngãi province|Quảng Ngãi]], damaging at least 20 homes.{{Cite web |date=2025-11-17 |title=Lốc xoáy quét qua ngôi làng ở Quảng Ngãi, nhiều mái nhà bị xé toạc |url=https://tuoitre.vn/loc-xoay-quet-qua-ngoi-lang-o-quang-ngai-nhieu-mai-nha-bi-xe-toac-20251117083046964.htm |access-date=2025-11-20 |website=TUOI TRE ONLINE |language=vi}} === November 25 (Philippines) === Two tornadoes were spawned by [[Typhoon Koto]] (Verbena). In [[Labangan, Zamboanga del Sur]] an EF1 tornado struck a village where at least 2 houses were damaged.{{Cite web |title=2 houses damaged by tornado in Zamboanga del Sur |url=https://www.gmanetwork.com/regionaltv/news/111610/2-houses-damaged-by-tornado-in-zamboanga-del-sur/story/ |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=www.gmanetwork.com |language=en}} In [[Nabas, Aklan|Nabas]] and [[Tangalan, Aklan]], an EF2 tornado tore off roofs of multiple houses, and snapped trees.{{Cite web |date=2025-11-25 |title=𝐈𝐍 𝐏𝐇𝐎𝐓𝐎𝐒: Padayon makaron ro paglibot it aton nga Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Team sa pila ka mga barangay sa munisipalidad it Tangalan agod nga sayuron ro nangin epekto it nag-eontad nga buhawi makaron nga hapon, Nobyembre 25. |url=https://www.facebook.com/100068319457699/posts/1162261866061118/?mibextid=rS40aB7S9Ucbxw6v |access-date=2026-08-17 |website=Facebook}}{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/r8zFHouFOEU |title=Buhawi, naminsala kasabay ng bagyo {{!}} GMA Integrated Newsfeed Bytes |language=en |access-date=2026-08-16 |via=www.youtube.com}}{{clear}} == December == === December 8 (Brazil) === [[File:2025 Dec Flores da Cunha tornado.jpg|thumb|A sports gymnasium partially destroyed by the tornado.]] On December 8, a significant tornado struck the municipality of [[Flores da Cunha]] in the state of [[Rio Grande do Sul]], Brazil, causing extensive structural damage in the rural community of [[Alfredo Chaves, Flores da Cunha|Alfredo Chaves]]. The tornado tore roofs off dozens of homes, damaged public buildings including a school and a health unit, and uprooted trees, leaving many residents’ houses exposed to the elements. Aerial and field assessments by local civil defense authorities identified damage patterns consistent with tornadic winds exceeding {{convert|100|km/h|mph|abbr=on}}, and between 40 and 80 homes were reported damaged, with agricultural areas such as vineyards also affected. Power outages left approximately 1,000 customers without electricity, and municipal emergency teams, supported by state defense forces and volunteer firefighters, conducted debris removal and structural safety inspections. No fatalities or serious injuries were reported, though hundreds of residents were affected by the storm's impacts.
